// LaTeX Suite 用户 snippets —— 整理版 (organized)
//
// 来源 : data.json 的 snippets 字段 (插件设置页中可编辑的原文; 解析后 367 条)
// 性质 : 仅【分组 / 注释 / 排版】整理 —— 所有 trigger / replacement / options /
//       priority / description 均逐字保留, 未改动任何快捷键 (与原文件行为等价)。
// 使用 : 内容为 JS 数组字面量 (同插件默认 snippet 源格式), 可直接整体替换设置页内容,
//       亦可作为后续插件开发的底稿。
// 注   : 按功能分组 (组序与原文件一致); 各组内注释与条目保持原相对顺序;
//       原文件中被注释 / 停用的旧条目集中于文末 [附录] 保留。
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [MathMode]  数学模式与分隔符 (行内 $…$ / 行间 $$…$$ / \begin 模板 / \displaystyle)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: "mk", replacement: "$$0$", options: "tA"},
{trigger: "dm", replacement: "$$\n$0\n$$", options: "tAw"},
{trigger: "beg", replacement: "\\begin{$0}\n$1\n\\end{$0}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "align", replacement: "$$\n\\begin{align}\n$1\n\\end{align}\n$$", options: "tAw"},
{trigger: "disp", replacement: "\\displaystyle", options: "mA"},

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [CJK]  中文标点 → 半角 (数学模式下自动把中文标点转 ASCII)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: "，", replacement: ",", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "》", replacement: ">", options: "mA"},
{trigger: ",，", replacement: ",~", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "（", replacement: "($0)$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "(）", replacement: "(", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "：", replacement: ":", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "’", replacement: "'", options: "mA"},

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [Aggro]  粗暴自动数学化 (整句/前缀触发, priority -2, 风险区)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: /\s*([^$\s]+)\s*(\?|<<)/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]]$$0 ", options: "rtA", priority: -2},// 全进去
{trigger: /([\u4e00-\u9fa5\u3000-\u303f\uff00-\uffef]+)\s*([^$\s\u4e00-\u9fa5\u3000-\u303f\uff00-\uffef]+)\s*([?？])/, replacement: "[[0]] $\u200B[[1]]$$0 ", options: "rtA", priority: -2},// 汉语环境中自动数学化（较为暴力）

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [AutoQ]  自动进入数学模式 (?/？ 触发链: 单字/下标/函数/小数/百分数/分式… 及后续变换)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: /\s*([A-Za-z]|\d+)\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 替换单字
{trigger: /\s*([A-Za-z])\.([0-9a-zA-Z])\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $[[0]]_{[[1]]}$ ", options: "rtA"},// 替换下标
{trigger: /\s*([A-Za-z]\s*\([0-9a-zA-Z]\))\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $[[0]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 替换一元函数
{trigger: /\s*([A-Za-z]\s*\([0-9a-zA-Z],\s*[0-9a-zA-Z]\))\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $[[0]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 替换二元函数
{trigger: /\s*(\d+\.\d+)\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 替换小数
{trigger: /\s*(\d+.\d+)%\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]]\\%$ ", options: "rtA"},// 替换百分比
{trigger: /\s*(\d+)\/(\d+)\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\\frac{[[0]]}{[[1]]}$ ", options: "rtA", priority:+1.5},// 替换分数
{trigger: /\s*\$([^$]*)\\frac([^$]*)\$\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $[[0]]\\dfrac[[1]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 切换分数显式形式 1
{trigger: /\s*\$([^$]*)\\dfrac([^$]*)\$\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $[[0]]\\frac[[1]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 切换分数显式形式 2
{trigger: /\s*\$([^$]*)\$\s*disp[?？]/, replacement: " $\\displaystyle [[0]]$ ", options: "rtA", priority:2},// 全显示
{trigger: /\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*\/\/[?？]/, replacement: " $\\frac{[[0]]}{$0}$ ", options: "rtA"},// 添分数线
{trigger: /\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*(\+|-){2}/, replacement: " $[[1]][[0]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 添正负号
{trigger: /\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*sq/, replacement: " $\\sqrt{[[0]]}$ ", options: "rtA"},// 添根号
{trigger: /\s*([a-zA-Z0-9])\s*\(\s*([^$(]*)\s*\$([^$]+)\$\s*\)\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $[[0]]([[1]][[2]])$ ", options: "rtA"},// 添函数
{trigger: /\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]][[1]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 合并
{trigger: /\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*,[?？]/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]],~[[1]]$ ", options: "rtA"},// 逗号合并
{trigger: /\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*\n[?？]/, replacement: "\n$$\n[[0]]\n$$\n$0", options: "rtA", priority:+1.6},// 转行间
{trigger: /\$([^$]+)\$\s*disp/, replacement: "$\\displaystyle [[0]]$ $0", options: "rtA", priority:+1.6},// 行间完整
{trigger: /\s*\n\s*\$\$\s*([^$]+)(\s*\n\s*\$\$)\s*</, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]]$ ", options: "rtA", priority:+1.6},// 转行内
{trigger: /\s\$\$([^$]+)\$\$\s*\n[?？]/, replacement: "\n$$\n\\begin{align}\n[[0]]\n\\end{align}\n$$\n$0", options: "rtA", priority:+1.6},// 转多行
{trigger: /\s*(\d*)\s*([A-Za-z])((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]][[1]][[2]][[4]][[5]][[7]][[8]]$ ", options: "rtA", priority:+1},// 一般单项
{trigger: /\s*\$([^$]+)\$\s*(\+|-|=)\s*(\d*)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\u200B[[0]][[1]][[2]][[3]][[4]][[6]][[7]][[9]][[10]]$ ", options: "rtA", priority:+1.1},// 右添项
{trigger: /\s*(\d*)\s*([A-Za-z])((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*(\+|-|=)\s*\$([^$]+)\$\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $[[0]][[1]][[2]][[4]][[5]][[7]][[8]][[10]][[11]]$ ", options: "rtA", priority:+1.1},// 左添项
{trigger: /\s\$([^$]+)\$\s*\/\s*(\d*)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*([A-Za-z]?)((\^[0-9a-zA-Z])?)\s*[?？]/, replacement: " $\\frac{[[0]]}{[[1]][[2]][[3]][[5]][[6]][[8]][[9]]}$ ", options: "rtA", priority:+1.2},// 下添项

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [Names]  专有名词 (Itô, Lévy, Fréchet, Hölder → 带重音写法)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: "Ito", replacement: "Itô ", options: "tA"},
{trigger: "Levy", replacement: "Lévy ", options: "tA"},
{trigger: "Frechet", replacement: "Fréchet ", options: "tA"},
{trigger: "Holder", replacement: "Hölder ", options: "tA"},

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [Greek]  希腊字母 (短代码 → \alpha 等; phi/psi 大小写与变体)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: "@a", replacement: "\\alpha", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@b", replacement: "\\beta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@D", replacement: "\\Delta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@d", replacement: "\\delta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@g", replacement: "\\gamma", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@G", replacement: "\\Gamma", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "del", replacement: "\\delta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "eps", replacement: "\\varepsilon", options: "mA"},
{trigger: ":e", replacement: "\\epsilon", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@z", replacement: "\\zeta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@t", replacement: "\\theta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@T", replacement: "\\Theta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: ":t", replacement: "\\vartheta", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@i", replacement: "\\iota", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@k", replacement: "\\kappa", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@l", replacement: "\\lambda", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@L", replacement: "\\Lambda", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@s", replacement: "\\sigma", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@S", replacement: "\\Sigma", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@u", replacement: "\\upsilon", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@U", replacement: "\\Upsilon", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@o", replacement: "\\omega", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "@O", replacement: "\\Omega", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "ome", replacement: "\\omega", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "Ome", replacement: "\\Omega", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "phi", replacement: "\\varphi", options: "mA", priority:2},
{trigger: "psi", replacement: "\\psi", options: "mA"},
{trigger: ":p", replacement: "\\phi", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "Phi", replacement: "\\varPhi", options: "mA", priority:2},
{trigger: "Psi", replacement: "\\varPsi", options: "mA", priority:2},
{trigger: "PI", replacement: "\\Pi", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "_{t}au", replacement: "_{\\tau}", options: "mA"},

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [TextEnv]  文本环境 (\text{…}、双引号、re\text{a.s.} 等)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: "text", replacement: "\\text{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "\"", replacement: "\\text{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "re\\text{a.s.} on", replacement: "{\\scriptsize($0)}$1", options: "mA"},

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [BasicOps]  基本运算与常用算子 (上下标、幂、根号、分式、\mathrm、间距、a.s./a.e./s.t. 等)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: "inv", replacement: "^{-1}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "hiv", replacement: "^{-\\frac{1}{2}}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "hp", replacement: "^{\\frac{1}{2}}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "fp", replacement: "^{1}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "sr", replacement: "^{2}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "cb", replacement: "^{3}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "cc", replacement: "^{c}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "pn", replacement: "^{n}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "tt", replacement: "^{\\top}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "oo", replacement: "\\circ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "xx", replacement: "\\times", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "_", replacement: "_{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "^", replacement: "^{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "Cnk", replacement: "\\binom{$0}{$1}$2 ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "sts", replacement: "_\\text{$0}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "VV", replacement: "\\vee", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "WW", replacement: "\\wedge", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "sq", replacement: "\\sqrt{ $0 }$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "//", replacement: "\\frac{$0}{$1}$2", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "ee", replacement: "\\mathrm{e}^{ $0 }$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: /([^\\])(exp|log|ln)/, replacement: "[[0]]\\[[1]]", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "\\exp", replacement: "\\exp\\left( $0 \\right) $1", options: "m"},
{trigger: "conj", replacement: "^{*}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "Re", replacement: "\\mathrm{Re}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "Im", replacement: "\\mathrm{Im}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "bf", replacement: "\\boldsymbol{$0}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "rmf", replacement: "\\mathrm{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "qd", replacement: "\\quad ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "qqd", replacement: "\\qquad ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: ",,", replacement: ",~ ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "const", replacement: "\\text{const.} ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "([^c])as", replacement: "[[0]]\\text{a.s.} ", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "ae", replacement: "\\text{a.e.} ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "st", replacement: "~~\\text{s.t.}~~ ", options: "mA"},

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [LinAlg]  线性代数 (det/tr/dim/rank/ker/diag 自动加反斜杠)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: /([^\\])(det)/, replacement: "[[0]]\\[[1]]", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "trs", replacement: "\\mathrm{tr}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "dim", replacement: "\\mathrm{dim}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "rank", replacement: "\\mathrm{rank}", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "ker", replacement: "\\mathrm{ker}\\; ", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "diag", replacement: "\\mathrm{diag} ", options: "mA"},

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [MoreOps]  智能上下标与字母记号 (auto sub/superscript、hat/bar/dot/vec/tilde 家族、修正链)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    // better subscripts
{trigger: "([A-Za-z]|${GREEK})\\.([A-Za-z]|[0-9])", replacement: "[[0]]_{[[1]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -1.5}, // 自动下标
{trigger: "([A-Za-z]|${GREEK})'([A-Za-z]|[0-9])", replacement: "[[0]]^{[[1]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -1.5},// 自动上标
{trigger: "}'([A-Za-z]|[0-9])", replacement: "}^{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -2}, // 粗暴上标
{trigger: "}_([A-Za-z]|[0-9])", replacement: "}_{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -2}, // 粗暴下标
{trigger: /\^{([^}]+)}\^{([^}]+)}\s?[?？]/, replacement: "^{[[0]]^{[[1]]}}", options: "rmA", priority: -2},// 重上标兼容
{trigger: /_{([^}]+)}_{([^}]+)}\s?[?？]/, replacement: "_{[[0]]_{[[1]]}}", options: "rmA", priority: -2},// 重下标修正
{trigger: /(\^|_){([^}]+)(\^|_){([^}]+)}}\s?[?？]/, replacement: "[[0]]{[[1]][[3]]}", options: "rmA"},// 兼容方案切换
{trigger: /_{(\d)}(\d)/, replacement: "_{[[0]][[1]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -1.5},// 双数字下标
{trigger: /_{([A-Za-z]|[0-9])}([A-Za-z]|[0-9])\s*[?？]/, replacement: "_{[[0]][[1]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -1.75},// 粗暴双下标
{trigger: /(_|\^){([a-z])}(\+|-)(\d)\s*[?？]/, replacement: "[[0]]{[[1]][[2]][[3]]}", options: "rmA"},// 上下标加减
{trigger: /(_|\^){(\d|[i-n])}hf/, replacement: "[[0]]{[[1]]+\\frac{1}{2}}", options: "rmA"},// 上下标半加
{trigger: /(_|\^){(\d|[i-n])}nhf/, replacement: "[[0]]{[[1]]-\\frac{1}{2}}", options: "rmA"},// 上下标半减
{trigger: /}>\s*([^>?$]+)\s*[?？]/, replacement: "[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -1.75},// 粗暴任意
{trigger: /\.[>\s]?([^>?$]+)\s*[?？]/, replacement: "_{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -2},// 粗暴任意下标
{trigger: /_{([^{}]+)}\s?([^?${}]+)\s*[{]/, replacement: "_{[[1]]}", options: "rmA", priority: 1},// 粗暴下标替换
{trigger: /\^{([^{}]+)}\s?([^?${}]+)\s*[{]/, replacement: "^{[[1]]}", options: "rmA", priority: 1},// 粗暴上标替换
{trigger: /'[>\s]?([^>?$]+)\s*[?？]/, replacement: "^{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -4},// 最粗暴
{trigger: /}[>\s]?([^>?$}]+)\s*[}]/, replacement: "[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -4.1},// 最粗暴放进括号里
{trigger: /}>([^>?$]+)\s*[}]/, replacement: "[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -4.1},// 最粗暴放进括号里
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])hat", replacement: "\\hat{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},//直接加帽子
{trigger: /\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL})\s?hat/, replacement: "\\hat{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},//希腊字母加帽子
{trigger: /\\(boldsymbol|mathbb|mathcal|mathscr|mathrm|mathfrak){([^}]+)}\s?hat/, replacement: "\\hat{\\[[0]]{[[1]]}}", options: "rmA"},    //特殊符号加帽子
{trigger: /(\\)?([a-zA-Z]|${GREEK}|\\${SYMBOL})(_|\^){([^}]+)}\s?hat/, replacement: "\\hat{[[0]][[1]]}[[2]]{[[3]]}", options: "rmA"}, // 带标加帽
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])wd", replacement: "\\widehat{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL})\s?wd/, replacement: "\\widehat{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(boldsymbol|mathbb|mathcal|mathscr|mathrm|mathfrak){([^}]+)}\s?wd/, replacement: "\\widehat{\\[[0]]{[[1]]}}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /(\\)?([a-zA-Z]|${GREEK}|\\${SYMBOL})(_|\^){([^}]+)}\s?wd/, replacement: "\\widehat{[[0]][[1]]}[[2]]{[[3]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])bar", replacement: "\\bar{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL})\s?bar/, replacement: "\\bar{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(boldsymbol|mathbb|mathcal|mathscr|mathrm|mathfrak){([^}]+)}\s?bar/, replacement: "\\bar{\\[[0]]{[[1]]}}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /(\\)(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL})(_|\^){([^}]+)}\s?bar/, replacement: "\\bar{[[0]][[1]]}[[2]]{[[3]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /([a-zA-Z])(_|\^){([^}]+)}\s?bar/, replacement: "\\bar{[[0]]}[[1]]{[[2]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])dot", replacement: "\\dot{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: -1},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])ddot", replacement: "\\ddot{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: 1},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])tilde", replacement: "\\tilde{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL})\s?tilde/, replacement: "\\tilde{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(boldsymbol|mathbb|mathcal|mathscr|mathrm|mathfrak){([^}]+)}\s?tilde/, replacement: "\\tilde{\\[[0]]{[[1]]}}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /(\\)?([a-zA-Z]|${GREEK}|\\${SYMBOL})(_|\^){([^}]+)}\s?tilde/, replacement: "\\tilde{[[0]][[1]]}[[2]]{[[3]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])wt", replacement: "\\widetilde{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(${GREEK}|${SYMBOL})\s?wt/, replacement: "\\widetilde{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /\\(boldsymbol|mathbb|mathcal|mathscr|mathrm|mathfrak){([^}]+)}\s?wt/, replacement: "\\widetilde{\\[[0]]{[[1]]}}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: /(\\)?([a-zA-Z]|${GREEK}|\\${SYMBOL})(_|\^){([^}]+)}\s?wt/, replacement: "\\widetilde{[[0]][[1]]}[[2]]{[[3]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])und", replacement: "\\underline{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "(${GREEK}) und", replacement: "underline{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])ovl", replacement: "\\overline{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "(${GREEK}) ovl", replacement: "overline{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])vec", replacement: "\\vec{[[0]]}", options: "rmA"},
{trigger: "([a-zA-Z])bf", replacement: "\\boldsymbol{[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: +1},
{trigger: /\\(${GREEK})\s?bf/, replacement: "\\boldsymbol{\\[[0]]}", options: "rmA", priority: +1},
{trigger: "hat", replacement: "\\hat{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "wd", replacement: "\\widehat{$0}$1", options: "mA", priority: -1},
{trigger: "wt", replacement: "\\widetilde{$0}$1", options: "mA", priority: -1},
{trigger: "bar", replacement: "\\bar{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "dot", replacement: "\\dot{$0}$1", options: "mA", priority: -1},
{trigger: "ddot", replacement: "\\ddot{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "cdot", replacement: "\\cdot", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "vec", replacement: "\\vec{$0}$1", options: "mA"},
    // More auto letter subscript

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [Symbols]  符号库 (运算符、关系、箭头、集合、花体/黑板体、概率符号)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{trigger: "wq", replacement: "\\infty", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "Lwq", replacement: "L^{\\infty}", options: "mA", priority:2},
{trigger: "lim", replacement: "\\lim_{ ${0:n} \\to ${1:\\infty} } $2", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "lmsp", replacement: "\\varlimsup_{ ${0:n} \\to ${1:\\infty} } $2", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "lmif", replacement: "\\varliminf_{ ${0:n} \\to ${1:\\infty} } $2", options: "mA"},
{trigger: ":sp", replacement: "\\limsup_{ ${0:n} \\to ${1:\\infty} } $2", options: "mA"},
{trigger: ":if", replacement: "\\liminf_{ ${0:n} \\to ${1:\\infty} } $2", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "mod", replacement: "\\;(\\mathrm{mod}\\;$0)$1", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "min", replacement: "\\min", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "\\min", replacement: "\\min_{$0}$1", options: "m"},
{trigger: "\\min_\{", replacement: "min\\\{$0\\", options: "rm"},
{trigger: "max", replacement: "\\max", options: "mA"},
{trigger: "\\max", replacement: "\\max_{$0}$1", options: "m"},
{trigger: "\\max_\{", replacement: "max\\\{$0\\", options: "rm"},
{trigger: "_\{_", replacement: "\\underset\{\}\{", options: "mA", priority: 1.5},
{trigger: "^\{^", replacement: "\\overset\{\}\{", options: "mA", priority: 1.5},
{trigger: "argmax", replacement: "\\underset\{$0\}\{\\text\{argmax\}\}\\;$1", options: "rmA", priority: 1.5},
{trigger: "argmin", replacement: "\\underset\{$0\}\{\\text\{argmin\}\}\\;$1", options: "rmA", priority: 1.5},

			const mid = t.slice(i + 1, cmdStart(t.length - 1));
			for (let k = 0; k < mid.length; k++) if (mid[k] === "$" && mid[k-1] !== "\\") return false;
			return t.slice(0, cmdStart(i)) + shells[0] + "(" + mid + shells[1] + ")"; // 行尾即 ),其后无残留
		}
	}
	return false;
}, options: "rmA", priority: 2, description: "suffix resets the outer shell of the paired parens"},
]
